academicFindings.cohort: Coherent 2024-entry cohort: B1 in the adopted 2024–25 OER, B2 in the adopted 2025–26 OER, and pre-September-2025 programme B3 in the adopted 2026–27 OER. The 2026–27 reformed B1/B2 cannot be combined with this older B3. Three 60 EC years total 180 EC: 124 compulsory, 40 restricted choice, 16 genuine open electives. B2 selects one period-2 theme (Emotion) and one period-3 theme (Development of Pro- and Antisocial Behaviour), plus the permitted 4 EC B3 elective Consciousness and Perception in B2 period 4. B3 selects Brain & Cognition, its required matching 6 EC domain course and a second 6 EC domain course, 4 EC applied methods, three distinct 4 EC domain electives, 4 EC ethics, 16 EC open space and 12 EC thesis. The B2 elective is not repeated in B3. These are permitted official-order examples, not an individual entitlement or a promised future entrant timetable.
